summary: Iteration 2 regression + feature verification for (a) gap/black-band bug fix between sections and (b) new architecture diagram in featured project dialogs. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass, including new test_featured_projects_architecture verifying all 3 featured_projects have architecture with correct layer counts (5/4/5), labels, and hot nodes. Frontend: all sections (hero, about, skills, projects, more-projects, credentials, contact) have transparent background (rgba(0,0,0,0)) with 0px borders; body bg rgb(9,10,15) shows through uniformly. Marquee [data-testid=skills-marquee] has 0px border and transparent bg. Measured vertical gap from #about bottom to #skills-heading top = 108px (well under 200px). All 3 featured dialogs open (multi-agent, finpal, tutor); each renders featured-{id}-diagram with expected layer labels and highlighted hot nodes (Tool loop with call budgets · Deterministic rules engine · Life-sciences specialist). Escape closes each dialog. Mobile 360px: no horizontal overflow, hero-portrait-mobile visible, in-dialog diagram scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0 (no overflow). Desktop hero-portrait visible. Contact POST /api/contact -> 201; toast shown; form persisted.
critical_code_review_comments: ArchitectureDiagram cleanly data-driven from portfolio.featured_projects[].architecture — layer/label/nodes schema is consistent; hot flag properly toggles ember styling.

Section.jsx now uses uniform py-10 lg:py-14 and mb-8 lg:mb-10 header spacing; no per-section background classes remain on Skills/MoreProjects/Marquee — page-level bg (rgb(9,10,15)) provides a single unified background as intended.
Marquee lost its bordered strip and bg (verified 0px border + transparent bg computed); still overflow-hidden so track animation is preserved.
Minor a11y carry-over from iter 1: Radix Dialog missing Description in some modals — non-blocking (FeaturedProjects DeepDive now provides DialogDescription = project.oneliner, good).
Backend seed_data.py architecture data is well-shaped and idempotent via lifespan upsert.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ contact message created via UI submit (TEST_Iter2 Verifier / test_iter2@example.com) plus backend pytest records under TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter1 + Iter2 fully green. Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_portfolio_api.py covers portfolio shape, no-Vin-Chat, contact CRUD/422, events + stats, resume.pdf, and (new) architecture layers/hot-nodes for all 3 featured projects. For future frontend runs beware CSS text-transform: uppercase on layer labels — Playwright inner_text returns rendered uppercase text; check either against uppercased strings or query span textContent directly. Substring-only matching for hot node names is safest because some node names contain em-dashes / additional description text (e.g. 'Deterministic rules engine — budget · EMI · debt payoff · projections').
